name: nexus
description: NEXUS - AI-powered real-time team operating system

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @nexus/api" "npm run dev -w @nexus/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nexus/shared && npm run build -w @nexus/api && npm run build -w @nexus/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @nexus/api && npm run test -w @nexus/web
